name: Arturo Buitrago Méndez
headline: Co-Founder @ KNOWRON
summary:
Multifaceted graduate of Electrical Engineering at Technical University of Munich. Born and raised in Costa Rica, stood out in the German School of San José due to my skills in math and languages, I was awarded a generous scholarship for outstanding graduates of German Schools by the DAAD (Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst) upon completion of my Abitur.

I have been studying in Munich since 2013 and have continued to maintain a high level in my field of studies, focusing on digital technologies, software development and AI. I have also acted in the capacity of a tutor to younger students for two different courses and enjoy transmitting my knowledge to others. 

My fluency in three languages, as well as natural tendency to look for diplomatic solutions to conflicts have put me in natural leadership positions before, both inside and outside university. I'm also interested in management as a way to harness these energies as well as put my people skills to work in productive ways.

I have recently concluded my Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering and Information Technology at the Technical University of Munich (TUM), as well as an Honors Degree in Technology Management at the Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM).

positions.title: Student Researcher in the Field of Machine Learning
positions.description: I applied machine learning algorithms for time-series prediction of card transactions in small to medium-sized businesses. My work included incorporation of state-of-the-art benchmarks and was based on open source libraries. Code and resulting thesis are available upon request.

positions.title: Unity / C# Developer
positions.description: I developed augmented reality applications for large clients in the pharmaceutical and transportation industries using the Microsoft Hololens. I had direct liaison with the clients' stakeholders and decision makers and had full ownership of the development projects.

positions.title: Research Assistant (HiWi)
positions.description:
Continuing work from my thesis, worked on simulations of LTE-A network traffic. Most models and simulation were implemented on my own from standard specifications.
Coding work done on Python.

positions.title: Mentor for Stochastic Signals
positions.description:
Weekly Mentorship of younger students, included going over the lecture's topics and presenting examples and exercises in preparation for exam.
Material focuses around the mathematical description of signals with stochastic models for work in signal processing.

positions.title: Tutor for Digital Circuits
positions.description:
Weekly Tutorship of younger students, included going over the lecture's topics and presenting examples and exercises.
Material focuses around the design and analysis of basic digital circuits and MOSFETs.

company.name: KNOWRON
company.tagline: Empowering industrial workers with an AI-based digital assistant.
company.description:
🧠 What if every technician had the knowledge of the entire company right in their pocket?
With KNOWRON, that vision becomes reality.
KNOWRON is an AI-powered assistant for smartphones and desktops – purpose-built for service technicians, industrial workers, and other deskless professionals.
Our solution delivers your organization’s knowledge exactly where it’s needed: on site – fast, intuitive, and voice-driven.

Key Features:
🔍 Natural Language Search
Find answers in seconds – through AI-powered search across manuals, protocols, and internal documents.

📚 Closing Knowledge Gaps
KNOWRON identifies frequently asked questions and automatically generates tailored, company-specific knowledge articles.

🛠️ Smart Instructions & Training
Create step-by-step instructions and interactive training modules – for seamless onboarding and continuous learning.

📝 Automated Documentation
Generate standardized, audit-ready service reports via voice input – fast, accurate, and effortless.
